title: PerturbNMF: an end-to-end pipeline for consensus NMF on single-cell perturbation data
description:
PerturbNMF runs and evaluates consensus Non-negative Matrix Factorization (cNMF) on single-cell perturbation data such as CRISPR screens, and is designed for SLURM-based HPC execution.

The pipeline has three stages:

  • Stage 1 — Inference: cNMF via sk-cNMF (CPU, scikit-learn) or torch-cNMF (GPU, PyTorch), with batch, minibatch, and parallel SLURM runners, producing a MuData file of program scores and gene loadings.
  • Stage 2 — Evaluation: nine program-quality metrics (categorical association, perturbation sensitivity, motif enrichment, GWAS/OpenTargets trait enrichment, GO and geneset enrichment, explained variance, reconstruction error, stability), plus three perturbation-calibration methods (U-test, conditional randomization test, and matched-cell differential expression).
  • Stage 3 — Interpretation: K-selection and per-program QC plots, perturbation plots, Excel summarization, and LLM-driven program annotation with PubTator3 literature mining.
